title: Avoid repeated conversation actions
rule: Do not repeat the same action or closing question across turns.
example: Answer the requested follow-up and stop when no further question is useful.
counterexample: End every turn with the same action and “What do you think?”
rationale: A repeated action or question should not become the response template.
evidence: Migrated from existing repository guidance: `deslopify/ne-fac/_template/models/xai/general.md`. Examples are illustrative.
